INTERVIEW INSIGHTS
From interview to instant AI insight.
Transform every interview into a confident, data-driven decision. Interview Insights combines structured, science-backed content with real-time AI assistance to make every hire a great hire.
Request Demo
“The more we can get to that place where it’s more around the attitude and the fit, then a lot of these elements and skills and competencies we can train for.”
– Richard Brearley
VP of Crew and Travel Operations at Carnival Cruise Line
From video interviewing to
intelligent
interviewing
As the pioneer of video interviewing, Hirevue is the trusted partner for organisations looking to elevate their video interviewing.
Interview Insights uses AI to identify and highlight moments in an interview that best demonstrate a candidate’s job-related skills. Start surfacing the insights hiring teams might otherwise miss when reviewing interviews at scale.
Assistive intelligence for every interview
Science-backed intelligence
that turns every interview into easy comprehension. Empower teams to make smarter, fairer, more confident decisions. AI-assistive technology delivers instant summaries, searchable transcripts, and interviewer benchmarks that accelerates hiring while enabling greater consistency.
End interview delays with instant AI insights
Build great teams faster with advanced AI that instantly generates smart transcripts, allows you to tag relevant experience, and review candidate competencies. Real-time AI summaries turn every interview into a chance for instant, informed hiring decisions for your entire team.
Stop losing top talent to poor experiences with high-quality interviews that never skip a beat. Interview Insights works with your existing tools, like Zoom and Teams—no disruption, just smarter decisions.
Validate skills, standardise evaluations, and accelerate decisions
AI-generated transcripts allow interviewers to tag relevant experience and competencies, helping turn average
video interviews
into insights that deliver role-specific, validated intelligence in real time. Validated, competency-based questions ensure every candidate is measured against consistent standards. Teams can review interview metrics to ensure talk times and questions are consistent. With Interview Insights, teams can:
Accelerate hiring
without sacrificing fairness.

and competencies instantly.

through data-driven consistency.

Frequently asked questions,
answered
Do I have to have video interviewing?
Yes, Interview Insights enhances the value of our structured interviewing product by offering easy to navigate summaries and overviews.
What is the value of pairing with an AI-scored interview?
Receive deeper level role-related explanations on the candidate along with the interview summary.
Can I search the transcripts?
Yes. You can also like, tag, and flag moments to dig in deeper or share with other reviewers.
